answer: Delayed work-history gate. Peers accept payments only from identities with at least 20 verified tasks and a 48-hour cooling period. A fresh identity starts at a lotus stage with zero history, so every clone must perform those tasks itself. Each completed task adds to a public terrace of noncopyable work record. Clones also face the same reef of delayed rewards: they pay per-task compute and a small nonrefundable deposit, with payout held until review. Per clone, the attacker pays 20 task runs, deposits, and two days of lost transaction access.
